summary: Revised implementation plan introducing a Windows 11 Out-of-Box Experience (OOBE) setup wizard for first-time launch and new-user reset. It walks the user through zero-waste app selection (choose which apps to keep or download to minimize internal storage consumption), hardware debloat selection for screenless Mini PCs, desktop theming and taskbar layout, with a one-click 'Reset for New User' option for refurbishers.
